Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rule 214(a)(2) of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, 18 C.F.R. § 385.214(a)(2), the Mississippi Public Service Commission (MPSC) hereby provides notice of intervention in Docket No. ER27-25-000 in which Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. seeks to establish its Large Load Addition Resource Study process.

The MPSC is the state regulatory agency empowered pursuant to Miss. Code Ann. §77-3-1, et seq., to regulate utilities operating within the State of Mississippi. The retail rates and services of the utilities regulated by the MPSC may be affected by the decision in this proceeding. As such, the MPSC has substantial, direct interests that may be affected by the outcome of this proceeding. Pursuant to FERC Rule 214(a)(2), 18 C.F.R. § 385.214(a)(2), the MPSC is entitled to intervene as a matter of right pursuant to timely filing of notice.

The MPSC respectfully request waiver of Rule 203(b) of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, 18 C.F.R. § 385.203(b), to the extent necessary to allow its representatives, submitted with this doc-less intervention, to be included on the official service list for this proceeding.
